receipt: Darcy pre-registration v1, Amendment A4 verification rerun (A1 to A4); a new experiment, not a retroactive validation of v1

solver_rule.name: a4
solver_rule.note: A4 rule, 1e-13 relative to ||b||_2; every acceptance threshold, case and parameter unchanged from v1

caveat: HYPOTHETICAL scenario, not Oklo; Darcy v1+A1-A3. Not a description of Oklo.
scope: Hypothetical numerical experiment on the revision 0 fixture geometry. It does not describe the hydrogeology of the Oklo reactors at any time. Nothing was fitted. Pore velocities use unsourced flow porosities except the core and are not physically validated.
ci: none; no continuous-integration run is implied

meta.run_command: cargo run --release --example darcy_run -- out/darcy_A4 receipts/darcy_v1_A4_run_2026-10-18.json <meta> a4

porosity_roles.flow_phi_z: per zone, enters only pore velocity

lambda_m_w_mk.source: Robertson 1988 USGS OFR 88-441 eq. 6, fig. 10, 300 K, 5 MPa
lambda_m_w_mk.range_includes: phi_th 0.10 to 0.25 and quartz 0 to 100 percent

pe_definition: Pe = rho_w c_p,w |q| L / lambda_m, L = 0.5 m voxel scale (A1.1); screening only

checks.detail: all eleven configurations: eps <= 1e-10, global <= 1e-10, residual paths <= 1e-12; see configurations[].d1
all eleven configurations within 10 N^3 iterations at the pre-registered rule

states.pe_limitation: lambda_m measured at 300 K and 5 MPa, applied uncorrected for temperature and pressure

pore_velocity.phi_z_basis: midpoint of 10-15% open porosity, Gauthier-Lafaye et al. 1996 p. 4834 citing Naudet 1991
